hero.headline: Roof restorations and leak repairs in Mooroolbark, done properly.

skyeGreeting: G'day, I'm the Nixon Roofing assistant. Got a leak, a tired-looking roof or some cracked pointing? Tell me what's going on and I'll help you get a free quote or book a time.

about.headline: You keep the family dry. We keep the roof over them.
about.body: When a roof needs work, most people want the same things: a tradie who picks up the phone, a straight answer about what actually needs doing, and a price before anything starts. Every job is handled that way, from a single cracked ridge cap to a full restoration.

about.closing: Not sure what your roof needs? Send a few photos and we'll give you honest advice.

realReviews.author: Chelsea Speedie
realReviews.text:
Highly recommend Brent from Nixon Roofing Repairs & Restorations! We recently had our old roof repaired and resprayed, and we couldn’t be happier with the result. Our roof was quite difficult and in need of some serious TLC, but Brent did an amazing job and made it look brand new again!
He was professional, reliable and took the time to do the job properly. We’re absolutely wrapped with how it turned out and couldn’t recommend Brent and Nixon Roofing highly enough!

realReviews.author: Simon Catterall
realReviews.text:
Brenten did an amazing job. He made an effort to go above an beyond in the service he quoted for and provided.
He was responsive, friendly, and provided me excellent advice for my roof. Plus, just look at the quality of his work. I cannot recommend him enough.
Thanks again!

realReviews.author: Jaffer Tambuwala
realReviews.text: Brent just did complete restoration of our 24 years old home roof. We found him highly professional & perfect in his job. Soft spoken & easy to talk to. Our best wishes are to him & his business. Well done.

finalCta.headline: Got a leak or a roof that's seen better days?
finalCta.body: Send a few photos or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a free quote before any work is booked.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just honest advice about your roof.

faq.a: Yes. Send a few details and photos through the form or give Brent a ring, and you'll get a price before any work starts.
Mooroolbark and the eastern suburbs and Yarra Ranges, including Lilydale, Croydon, Mount Evelyn, Ringwood, Yarra Glen, Healesville and Yarra Junction. Close by but not on the list? Ask anyway.

faq.q: Do I need a full restoration or just repairs?
faq.a: Not always a restoration. Sometimes rebedding, pointing or a few new tiles is all it needs. We'll have a proper look and tell you honestly.
Ask when you request your quote and we'll send the licence and insurance details for your job.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to book a roof check.
